correctness.rationale: Independently eliminated the four source fast-variable critical equations via P=c_p z and T=c_t z²: κP+κδT=R0−1, B=P+κT, R0y=1+B, and z=[1−(1−q)(B+1)/R0]/(a+R0). Solving P,T yields the stated unique t∈[0,1] nonnegative parameterization. In SymPy exact identities κP+κδT=A and P+κT=B vanish, and the normalized chord identity simplifies exactly to 1. Solving z(1)=0 yields qmin=2(R0−1)/(nR0−2); q>qmin gives positive z on branch. For q<1, z(1)<z(0) and strict interior synergy; q=1 gives equality. Restricted to closure threshold, not stochastic process.
